title: ado_story_report story selection
description: Narrows which done stories ado_story_report.py analyses.

areaPaths.description: Area path filter. A pattern matches the area and everything below it. Wildcards: '*' within one level, '**' across levels, '?' one character. Case-insensitive. Exclude wins over include; an empty include means every area.

createdSince.description: Only stories created on or after this date.

requireTasks.description: Only stories with at least one child work item (the tasks pull requests are usually linked from).
